source_full_text: In the midst of all the noise and rejoicing Labakan slipped off with his little box under his arm. He went to the stables, saddled his old horse, Murva, And rode out of the gate towards ALEXANDRIA. Nothing but the ivory box with its diamond motto was left to show him that the last few weeks had not been a dream.

reference_text: 在一片喧嚣与欢庆之中，拉巴坎悄悄地夹着他的小盒子走了。他来到马厩，给他的老马穆尔瓦套上马鞍，然后骑马出了城门，朝亚历山大城而去。除了那个镶有钻石题词的象牙盒子，再没有什么能证明过去几周不是一场梦了。
